title: Oceanvancements
description: This project adds a new advancements tab focused on ocean adventure and exploration.
body:
# Oceanvancements Have you ever wanted advancements to guide and reward ocean adventuring in Minecraft? This datapack introduces a new advancement tab for all kinds of ocean features, from monuments to buried treasure, the nautilus, and more. Oceanvancements adds 16 new vanilla-style advancements to the game, as well as moving fishy business and connected advancements to the ocean tab. Step into the water to reveal a world of oceanic adventure!
Full Advancement List

- A Pirate's Life for Me (Dig Up a Buried Treasure)

- Aquarium Master (Collect Every Type of Sea Creature in a Bucket)

- Heir of Poseidon (Acquire a Trident)

- King of the Sea (Kill an Elder Guardian)

- Monumental (Discover a Monument)

- Now You're Thinking with Conduits (Activate a Conduit)

- Ocean Tab (Enter Water)

- Oceanic Guidance (Befriend a Dolphin)

- Oceanographer (Visit Every Ocean Biome)

- Oops (Smash a Turtle Egg)

- Pickle Me This (Place Four Sea Pickles on a Block)

- Sailing (Craft a Boat)

- Slow and Steady (Mine an Obsidian with Mining Fatigue)

- Takes Me Away (Boat 1000 Blocks)

- Tastes... Fishy (Eat a Pufferfish)

- This Boat Has Tentacles (Tame a Nautilus)

- Wings of the Sea (Launch Yourself with a Riptide Trident)
